title: Controllable CAD Generation and Interactive Editing of Fluid Rotors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-aided design (CAD) provides the geometric foundation for rotors in fluid rotating machinery. However, creating models for different rotors requires different modeling processes, making it difficult to control geometry through design intent and reuse existing models. We introduce VaneCraft, an agent-driven framework for rotor generation, inverse recovery, and editing through a unified analytical representation. The agent interprets design requests and invokes geometric modeling operations. The representation defines geometric controls through meridional geometry and independent boundary angle laws. An anisotropic partial differential equation (PDE) maps these controls to the blade surfaces. Geometric parameter correction (GPC) uses a joint geometric encoder and a parameter decoder to refine controls initialized from rotor category and dimensions. Inverse recovery maps existing CAD to the same geometric controls for reconstruction

translated_title: 流体转子的可控CAD生成与交互式编辑
translated_abstract: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）为流体旋转机械中的转子提供了几何基础。然而，为不同转子创建模型需要不同的建模流程，这使得通过设计意图控制几何形状以及复用现有模型变得困难。我们提出了VaneCraft，一个通过统一解析表示实现转子生成、逆向恢复与编辑的智能体驱动框架。该智能体解释设计请求并调用几何建模操作。该表示通过子午面几何和独立的边界角规律定义几何控制，并利用各向异性偏微分方程（PDE）将这些控制映射到叶片表面。几何参数校正（GPC）采用联合几何编码器和参数解码器，对由转子类别和尺寸初始化的控制参数进行优化。逆向恢复则将现有CAD映射到相同的几何控制以实现重建。
tldr: 提出VaneCraft框架，通过统一解析表示与智能体驱动的几何建模操作，实现流体转子的可控CAD生成、逆向恢复与交互式编辑。
en_tdlr: VaneCraft is an agent-driven framework that achieves controllable CAD generation, inverse recovery, and interactive editing of fluid rotors through a unified analytical representation.
